name: agent-whip
description: Crack a whip at a running AI coding agent session and it switches into a faster operating mode. A mode switch, not an interrupt.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspaces --if-present && npm run build:renderer && npm run build:main && npm run build:preload
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/paste-frame packages/core packages/cli && tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit
scripts.check: npm run check:no-network && npm run check:no-payload-logging && npm run check:public-hygiene && npm run check:reserved-terms
